headline: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux to Transform ChatGPT into a Super App
summary: The head of core products is spearheading a major overhaul to make the chatbot a personalized AI agent handling all aspects of users' lives.
details: OpenAI is undergoing a significant transformation of ChatGPT, aiming to evolve its interface into a personalized AI agent capable of managing tasks across both personal and professional spheres. This ambitious initiative is being referred to internally and externally as a "super app."

Thibault Sottiaux, recently appointed as OpenAI's head of core products, now oversees ChatGPT and Codex, merging them into the future super app. This move consolidates his influence as the company bets heavily on this new direction, having already shut down standalone products like its video app Sora.

Sottiaux, who previously played a key role in developing Codex, a rapidly growing revenue stream for OpenAI, is now tasked with revamping a consumer product used by nearly a billion people weekly. He described the challenge as "incredibly exciting and mildly terrifying."

The vision for the super app is to become the "world's best personal agent that deeply understands what humans care about." Sottiaux anticipates ChatGPT becoming "delightfully proactive" within the next year, delivering the right information precisely when needed.

This strategic shift aims to revitalize OpenAI's growth amidst intense competition from Google and Anthropic, as the company races towards an IPO. The bet is that a unified, personalized AI assistant will re-establish OpenAI as the leader in consumer, enterprise, and the overall AI landscape.

Sottiaux's background includes developing infrastructure for AI research at Google DeepMind, contributing to projects like AlphaGo. Inspired by ChatGPT's launch, he joined OpenAI in 2024, initially focusing on internal tools before building the highly popular Codex AI coding tool.

In his new role, Sottiaux is shifting focus from developer needs to the expectations of the average user. The super app is envisioned as a digital assistant with advanced memory, capable of tasks like making reservations and remembering dietary restrictions, or automating work tasks like expense reporting.
